instruction: With GIMP, load 'character.png', perform a horizontal flip, and export the flipped image as 'character_flipped.png' to your Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires flipping image horizontally using GIMP. Evaluator compares result image with horizontal flip of original using SSIM (structural similarity). Original image path in cache is used for comparison. High threshold (0.99) ensures flip was performed correctly.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies horizontal flip by comparing result image with programmatically flipped version of original using SSIM
Getter properly retrieves the exported file from VM Desktop location (/home/user/Desktop/character_flipped.png)
Metric uses appropriate SSIM threshold (0.99) to account for compression artifacts while ensuring flip accuracy
Expected state correctly references original image path in cache for comparison
Complete coverage: verifies both file existence at correct location AND correct horizontal flip transformation
Good error handling for missing files, load failures, and edge cases
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts result file -> metric compares against flipped original -> returns binary score
